root_idea.summary: The root centers on something rising, elevated, or standing out visibly.
root_idea.development: From elevation, the lexicon extends to a figure rising into view, departure, raised or fixed sight, an arrow overshooting its target, swelling, and bodily bulk. Derived forms also express causing elevation or movement and individuating something.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed under the singular active-participle citation form corresponding to the supplied feminine Quranic form.

senses.definition: To become fixedly open and staring; of the eyes or sight, to remain raised or stretched without blinking.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of the eyes or sight in the Quranic description of intense, motionless staring.

senses.definition: Fixedly open and staring, with the eyes held motionless and unblinking.
senses.usage_conditions: Active participle describing eyes or sight in the Quranic context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise, become elevated, or appear above or into view; said, for example, of a star or a visible figure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form I usage describing physical or visual elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise the voice so that it cannot be lowered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A vocal or speech construction; the Lane evidence also describes a word or sentence rising toward the palate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an arrow, to rise above and pass beyond the target or object of aim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an arrow overshooting by going above its intended target.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go away or travel from one place, town, or country to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive movement or departure from a place of residence or settlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise, swell, or become protuberant or prominent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a thing or to a wound that rises and becomes swollen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become disquieted by something that happens, or to have a disturbing event befall one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage presenting the disturbed person as if raised from the ground by agitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become big, bulky, or corpulent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes bodily size or build.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To individuate, identify, or specify a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II transitive usage meaning to assign a thing its particular identity or designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone or something rise or become elevated; to raise oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an archer or arrow, to cause an arrow to pass above and beyond the target.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative and intransitive formulations are both attested for an arrow overshooting its object of aim.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone go away or travel from one place to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative movement or departure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disquiet someone, causing him to leave a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative causative usage linking disturbance with departure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the time for journeying, to arrive or become due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An impersonal temporal construction concerning the time of departure or travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show someone a sour, crabbed, or austere face or manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a person as the object of the hostile or displeased look.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak ill of someone behind his back; to backbite him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV idiomatic usage concerning speech about an absent person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become individuated or assume the quality of individuality or personality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Quasi-passive or reflexive Form V usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A visible body, bodily form, figure, or material substance, especially one that has height and can be seen from a distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Physical usage applied to a person or another material object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person, individual, self, or being.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Extended usage for a person or personal entity, including metaphorical use for a self or being.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Big, bulky, corpulent, or great in bodily make.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing substantial bodily build.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lord, master, chief, person of rank, or personage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A designation of status or social standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sour, crabbed, or austere in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to language or manner of speaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bigness, bulkiness, or corpulence; greatness of bodily build.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of bodily size or substantial form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an arrow, passing beyond the target or object of aim by going above it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active-participial description of an overshooting arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person prosecuting war continuously for three or more days, rather than on alternate days.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized traditional usage associated with the traveler who may shorten prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A figured representation or image; in later usage, the singular of a term for coins stamped with figures or effigies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Later or modern usage; the source presents the citation and derivation tentatively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An individuated or specifically identified thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive-participial nominal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Discordant or at odds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to language or speech, and also to a thing or affair.

cautions: The modern verse keys and word locations in the examples are the supplied QAC locations; Lane's printed Quran references use historical citation conventions and are not independently converted here.

One Lane subunit prints سَخَصَتِ الكَلِمَةُ while a parallel subunit under the same entry explicitly gives the corresponding شَخَصَ voice usage; the raising-the-voice meaning is retained with this orthographic caution.
